Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review original research article that focuses on modeling renewable energy requirements for Indonesia’s new capital city (IKN) in East Kalimantan. While it uses land use/land cover (LULC) classification and urban growth scenarios as inputs, LULC prediction is not the primary objective. The study area is strictly regional/local (limited to the IKN planning area of ~180,000 ha in East Kalimantan), not national-scale. It fails the core inclusion criterion of "explicit national-scale spatial implementation." Additionally, although it references future urban expansion using the FUTURES model based on prior work (Hackbarth, 2021), the paper itself does not implement or quantitatively compare ≥2 novel LULC prediction scenarios with accuracy metrics; instead, it uses existing or assumed land use maps primarily to assess energy infrastructure siting. Thus, it meets exclusion criteria due to local/regional scale focus and lack of primary focus on LULC prediction.)
